title: Maintain Customer Trust and Transparency
description: Continue clear communication and fair support practices that help customers feel confident when purchasing.
actions: Keep returns, refunds, warranty, and contact details easy to find.
Respond to customer questions consistently.
Review policies whenever the offer or fulfilment process changes.
reasoning: Current trust-related feedback supports maintaining transparent and dependable practices.

title: Preserve Accurate Business Information
description: Keep store identity, product claims, contact channels, and policy information current and consistent.
actions: Check key pages and contact details periodically.
Ensure claims can be supported by available evidence.
Correct outdated information promptly.
reasoning: Accurate information reduces confusion and supports customer confidence.

title: Continue Responsive Customer Support
description: Maintain a support process that acknowledges customer concerns and explains the next steps clearly.
actions: Set realistic response expectations.
Use consistent case notes and follow-up.
Review resolved cases for recurring communication gaps.
reasoning: Reliable support helps sustain positive customer relationships.

title: Keep Returns and Refund Policies Clear
description: Make post-purchase options understandable before customers place an order.
actions: State eligibility, timeframes, and process clearly.
Explain any lawful exclusions in plain language.
Ensure support staff follow the published policy.
reasoning: Clear policies reduce uncertainty and prevent avoidable disputes.

title: Maintain Evidence-Based Product Claims
description: Ensure statements about authenticity, warranties, and product capabilities are supported and easy to verify.
actions: Retain supplier and warranty documentation where relevant.
Avoid absolute claims that cannot be substantiated.
Provide evidence to customers when appropriate.
reasoning: Verifiable claims help maintain trust without implying concerns where none are indicated.

title: Maintain Clear Customer Communication
description: Review customer-facing information to ensure it remains understandable and consistent throughout the purchase journey.
actions: Check policy pages and checkout wording.
Explain who customers can contact for help.
Align automated messages with current processes.
reasoning: Minor trust-related signals may be addressed through clearer and more consistent communication.

title: Make Support and Contact Options Easy to Find
description: Ensure customers can quickly locate a genuine support channel and understand when to expect a response.
actions: Display current contact options prominently.
Test contact forms and support links.
Provide a clear escalation route for unresolved cases.
reasoning: Accessible support channels reduce uncertainty when customers need assistance.

title: Review Return and Refund Clarity
description: Check whether customers can understand return and refund requirements before purchasing.
actions: Use plain language for steps and timelines.
Explain how customers receive case updates.
Check that operational practice matches the published policy.
reasoning: Policy clarity helps prevent misunderstandings that can affect customer confidence.

title: Keep Product and Warranty Details Consistent
description: Align product pages, order messages, and support guidance so customers receive the same accurate information.
actions: Compare key claims across customer touchpoints.
Clarify warranty coverage and exclusions.
Correct contradictory or outdated statements.
reasoning: Consistent information reduces avoidable confusion and disputes.

title: Use Customer Feedback to Improve Transparency
description: Review feedback for places where customers appear uncertain about policies, product claims, or support processes.
actions: Group questions by recurring theme.
Improve the relevant FAQ or policy wording.
Check later feedback to see whether confusion decreases.
reasoning: Feedback can identify where a small information improvement would be useful.

title: Improve Transparency and Customer Communication
description: Make product information, policies, and order communications easier to understand and verify.
actions: Keep descriptions and policy pages accurate.
Provide clear answers to common questions.
Send timely order and delivery updates.
reasoning: Recurring trust-related feedback suggests that transparency and communication deserve focused review.

title: Review Unresolved Customer Concerns
description: Identify repeated complaints about support, returns, refunds, or unclear information and ensure each has an owner.
actions: Group open cases by issue and age.
Clarify the next action and expected response time.
Review whether published policies match actual case handling.
reasoning: A structured review can reveal process gaps without assuming intentional misconduct.

title: Strengthen Refund and Return Handling
description: Make return and refund decisions consistent, traceable, and understandable to customers.
actions: Document each case and its decision basis.
Explain requirements and timelines before requesting further information.
Escalate exceptions using a defined process.
reasoning: Consistent case handling can reduce repeated disputes and improve confidence.

title: Verify Customer-Facing Claims
description: Check that important claims about products, warranties, seller identity, and service are accurate and supported.
actions: Review claims against available records.
Correct statements that are outdated or ambiguous.
Escalate material discrepancies for verification.
reasoning: Verifying claims is a proportionate response to uncertainty and avoids unsupported conclusions.

title: Improve the Customer Support Feedback Loop
description: Use recurring questions and complaints to improve the information customers receive before and after purchase.
actions: Tag support cases by theme.
Update FAQs and templates for frequent questions.
Review whether repeat questions decline after updates.
reasoning: A feedback loop helps resolve communication gaps at their source.

title: Restore Customer Trust and Improve Support
description: Investigate repeated concerns about support, returns, refunds, or product authenticity and provide clear, fair resolutions.
actions: Respond promptly and document each case.
Make return and refund options clear and consistent with policy.
Provide verifiable warranty or authenticity information when relevant.
reasoning: Repeated trust-related concerns require timely investigation and dependable customer support.

title: Investigate Material Trust Concerns
description: Review significant customer concerns carefully and distinguish verified facts from assumptions before taking action.
actions: Collect relevant order records, customer messages, and supplier documentation.
Check the specific claim with the responsible team or supplier.
Document findings and communicate the resolution accurately.
reasoning: A fact-based investigation protects customers while avoiding unsupported allegations.

title: Resolve Repeated Refund or Return Disputes
description: Review recurring disputes to determine whether policy wording, case handling, or fulfilment evidence needs improvement.
actions: Audit a sample of relevant cases.
Compare decisions with the published policy and applicable obligations.
Correct confirmed process inconsistencies and follow up with affected customers.
reasoning: Consistent, evidence-based handling can address repeated disputes and reduce further customer harm.

title: Clarify Authenticity and Warranty Evidence
description: Where customers raise credible questions, make relevant product provenance and warranty information easier to verify.
actions: Request and review supplier or warranty records where applicable.
Correct unclear claims and remove unsupported statements.
Share appropriate evidence without exposing confidential information.
reasoning: Transparent verification is more reliable than dismissing concerns or making unverified assurances.

title: Set Clear Ownership for Trust-Related Complaints
description: Create a consistent process for handling significant complaints so customers receive timely updates and outcomes.
actions: Assign an owner and response deadline to each case.
Use a standard record of evidence, decisions, and follow-up.
Escalate unresolved or legally sensitive cases to the appropriate lead.
reasoning: Clear ownership reduces the chance that serious customer concerns remain unresolved.

title: Investigate Critical Trust or Authenticity Concerns
description: Urgently assess credible evidence of serious customer harm, misleading claims, or product authenticity concerns before drawing conclusions.
actions: Preserve relevant listings, messages, order records, and supplier documents.
Escalate the case to responsible leadership and qualified advisers where needed.
Restrict a specific claim or listing only when evidence and applicable rules justify it.
reasoning: Serious trust concerns require prompt evidence preservation and proportionate escalation, not assumptions of fraud.

title: Protect Customers During a Serious Trust Incident
description: Coordinate a customer-protection response when verified information indicates a material and ongoing risk to buyers.
actions: Identify affected products and orders.
Provide accurate guidance and appropriate remedies to affected customers.
Follow applicable consumer-protection, platform, and reporting obligations.
reasoning: Customer protection should be prioritised when a material risk has been substantiated.

title: Verify Suspected Product Misrepresentation
description: Arrange an urgent review when important product or seller claims materially conflict with available evidence.
actions: Compare claims with supplier records and product documentation.
Correct or pause disputed claims while they are assessed when warranted.
Record the evidence, decision, and customer communication.
reasoning: A structured verification process helps prevent further reliance on potentially inaccurate information.

title: Escalate a Severe Customer-Protection Issue
description: Ensure a serious unresolved customer issue reaches an accountable decision-maker with the evidence needed to act.
actions: Appoint an incident owner and preserve case history.
Assess customer impact and applicable obligations.
Set deadlines for decisions, remedies, and customer updates.
reasoning: Escalation is appropriate when the potential impact or complexity exceeds routine support handling.

title: Confirm Corrective Actions Before Closing a Critical Case
description: Do not treat a serious trust incident as resolved until corrective steps and affected-customer follow-up have been verified.
actions: Confirm the disputed information or process has been corrected.
Track outstanding refunds, returns, or other agreed remedies.
Review later cases to check whether the same issue recurs.
reasoning: Verification helps ensure that a response resolves the customer impact rather than only closing the initial complaint.
